# UPchieve Changelog, week of Sep 19 to Sep 26, 2026

*Generated by Claude from merge-request and commit activity. Details may be inaccurate; check the linked MR or ask the author.*

Last deploys: high-line Sep 25, subway Sep 25. These deploys carried the session-holds, `ClaudeService`, session-list debounce, and primary-key work that last week's digest had as merged, approved, or in review.

**Status key:** 🚀 Launched (live to everyone) | 🧪 Experimental (in production, behind a feature flag) | 🎁 Merged (ships next deploy) | ✅ Approved (reviewed, not yet merged) | 👀 In review (needs review)

## NTHS

The National Tutoring Honors Society, where a high school coach founds a chapter at their own school. Moving the president application out of a Google form and into the app, along with the school and chapter records behind it.

- 🚀 **Replace the embedded Retool chapter dashboard with Chapter HQ, built into the app.** Five tabs. Home has a "Do this next" card for admins with the next unfinished setup step, a link to do it, and Mark as done; the invite link, which copies on click, beside invite scripts; the chapter's impact this school year, students helped and sessions completed, with good-standing meters against 40 hours tutored and 3 members tutoring; and the top tutor of the month. To do is the setup checklist, for admins only, and the honor-system items can be unchecked now. Members is the roster: each member's status (ready to tutor, training incomplete, needs safety approval, or account closed), filter chips including "Hasn't tutored" for the chosen period, sorting, sessions and hours for this week, the last 2 weeks, this month, this school year, or all time, making or removing an admin from each row, and for admins a CSV export that always carries join date and this school year's numbers plus the chosen period's. It remembers the period and sort, and plain members see it read-only. Resources links out to nationaltutor.org, and Chapter setup holds the name and school affiliation, which admins edit, and Leave Team. The old dashboard, manage-team, and settings URLs redirect to the new tabs. ([subway !2972](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2972), [high-line !1928](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1928); school year and all-time periods in [subway !2974](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2974), [high-line !1933](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1933)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Measure the NTHS funnel from the sidebar through Chapter HQ:** every Chapter HQ button, link, and tab carries an `nthshq` name through a new `v-ph` directive, so autocapture clicks read like `nthshq: members.download_csv` and can be broken down by which part of HQ gets used ([high-line !1934](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1934)); `NTHS_SIDEBAR_APPLY_LINK_SHOWN` fires when the Apply to NTHS link is on screen, with whether it leads to the application or the preview, so it can be funneled against the click, and on phones only once the sidebar is opened ([high-line !1924](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1924)); `NTHS_CIRCLE_COMMUNITY_LINK_CLICKED` actually fires now, since sidebar links that open a new tab were ignoring `onClick` ([high-line !1925](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1925)). *Ben Wheeler*
- 🧪 **Test a shorter chapter application.** The long form, the control, asks four open questions (why start a chapter, a time you took initiative or led a group, your top recruiting idea, and what will keep your coaches tutoring toward 40 hours) plus an optional co-president email. The short form keeps two: why start a chapter, and "When have you led a group or taken charge of something?" Both keep the commitments and "How did you hear about NTHS?". Answers save in the browser so a coach can pick up where they left off, and subway records which form each application used. Every coach who reaches the application is split 50/50 between the two ([`nths-short-application`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/908257)). ([subway !2973](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2973), [high-line !1930](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1930)) *Ben Wheeler*
- ✅ **Let an applicant enter a school outside the US.** The "I can't find my school" form asks for a country, starting on the one in their profile, with a searchable picker. A US school still needs a state; anywhere else takes an optional state, province, or region. ([subway !2980](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2980), [high-line !1935](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1935)) *Ben Wheeler*

## My Coaches

Making the connections our power users make available to all users, earlier on. It runs through knowing your tutor, favorite coach presence, DMing a coach from one place instead of Session History, and in time things like asking for a specific coach.

- 🚀 **Give students a card for each coach they have worked with.** "Past Coaches" in the sidebar becomes "My Coaches", at `/my-coaches`, and each coach gets a card with their first name, how many sessions you have had together, and a favorite toggle. It is the first step toward letting a student open a coach's card to see their sessions together and start or continue a conversation separate from session DMs. The favoriting toggle matches the design rather than the existing one, and the shared coach avatar stands in until coaches have their own. ([high-line !1922](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1922)) *Liseidy Bueno*
- **Let a coach choose what a student sees about them.** The opt-in was an experiment; this makes it a feature. 🎁 the fields a coach picks stored as an array on `volunteer_profiles`, so total hours, sessions, students helped, and occupation stay read from where they already live ([subway !2938](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2938)); 👀 that array becomes the source of truth instead of passing the information over sockets ([subway !2939](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2939), [high-line !1901](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1901)); 👀 a tutor info card shown to students and previewed by coaches ([high-line !1902](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1902)); 👀 the card on the student session view, collapsed to start so opening it can be counted ([high-line !1903](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1903)); 👀 the dashboard modal redesigned and shown once, with clicking outside it storing an empty array, and coaches who saw it during the experiment seeing it again ([high-line !1904](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1904)); 👀 the card added to background info in Edit Profile, where a coach can change their answer, and the feature flag removed ([high-line !1905](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1905)); 👀 tests on both sides ([subway !2944](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2944), [high-line !1911](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1911)). *Liseidy Bueno*

## Session holds

Revise the request dispatch algorithm to offer a new session to a few coaches one at a time, the way a library hold list runs down, before it goes to every coach online.

- 🧪 **Hold an incoming session for one coach at a time.** When a student joins, up to three coaches are picked at random from those who are online, ready to coach, certified in the subject and not muting it, and not in a session or holding another one. Each has the session to themselves for 10 seconds, so it reaches everyone online after 30 seconds at most, or sooner if they all pass. The coach sees a countdown, who is asking and for what subject, and Pass to another coach or Accept and start. The hold list is worked out once, when the student joins. A session is held only when both sides qualify: students who are not attached to a school partner and have had at least one session, in 6th grade math only, since holds are made only for subjects listed in the flag's payload ([`session-holds-student`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/907808)); and 20% of coaches who signed up this year and have had 2 to 5 sessions ([`session-holds-coach`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/907811)); plus the "Dogfood Eaters" cohort on both. ([subway !2946](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2946), [subway !2975](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2975); [high-line !1914](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1914)) *Jamie Kasulis*
- 🧪 **The pieces it runs on:** a log line for every hold created, to watch it early on ([subway !2978](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2978)); a `filterAsync` util ([subway !2945](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2945)); a countdown component, which can also count up ([high-line !1923](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1923)). *Jamie Kasulis*

## Session join under load

The fixes coming out of the Sept 8 investigation into the Sept 3 incident, when the database saturated and students could not get into sessions.

- 🚀 **Stop hammering the session list when requests arrive together:** the session-list emit is debounced to at most once every 250 ms and at least once a second, so a burst of requests no longer runs `getUnfulfilledSessions` for each one ([subway !2954](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2954)); with the debounce in place the dashboard alerts on a valid session even when it is not the newest, since the newest may be one the coach is not certified in ([high-line !1920](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1920)). *sammy nave*

## Claude on Bedrock and Foundry

Moving every AI call onto a `ClaudeService` that runs Claude on AWS Bedrock or Microsoft Foundry and fails over between them.

- 🚀 **Put every AI call behind one service with a deadline and a fallback.** Everything, including the safety calls, went through `invokeModel`, which had no fallback. Calls go through `ClaudeService` now, which orchestrates `AwsBedrockService` and `AnthropicFoundryService` as interchangeable Claude providers, moves to the next one on any error outside a denylist, and caps each provider at 30 seconds rather than the 10 minutes some calls could reach. It also fixes Sonnet sometimes emitting thinking tokens into the answer, by pulling the data out of the response by content type instead of by array index. ([subway !2966](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2966)) *Chris*

## Quick wins, fixes, chores, and other small things

- 🚀 **Keep unapproved volunteers out of the session list:** high-line waits for `approved` as well before asking for the list ([high-line !1913](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1913)); subway only lets approved volunteers into the `volunteers` socket room ([subway !2958](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2958)). *Alex Lindsay*
- **Make every table replication-ready, and keep it that way:** 🚀 primary keys added to the `upchieve` tables without one, since logical replication needs a replica identity and the alternatives are an index to remember or `REPLICA IDENTITY FULL`, which streams whole rows, makes the subscriber scan for each one, and rules out the replica masking Aiven's PostgreSQL Anonymizer now offers ([subway !2942](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2942)); 🚀 a test that fails if a table has no primary key ([subway !2943](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2943)); 🚀 comments written for the columns that were missing them, mostly the new `id` columns ([subway !2949](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2949)); 🚀 a test that fails if a column has no `COMMENT`, so a migration cannot add one without ([subway !2950](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2950)); 👀 PostgreSQL Anonymizer available on a local database, to try out the security labels that will mask PII on the replica ([subway !2986](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2986)). *Alex Lindsay*
- **Trust only what the SSO provider returns:** 🎁 a signup is marked verified only on federated credentials that came back from SSO, not ones sent in the request, and the two now travel as separate arguments ([subway !2970](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2970)); 👀 Clever and ClassLink sign-in check an OAuth2 `state` token, closing a login CSRF where an attacker could get a victim signed into the attacker's account ([subway !2979](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2979)). *Alex Lindsay*
- 👀 **Send every student's school to PostHog, not only partner students'.** The only school property, `partnerSchoolId`, is set by the frontend at login for school-partner students, so it misses anyone who has not logged in since and could not back a school cohort: 1,421 people across 70 schools had it. A `schoolId` person property from `users_schools` is synced from the backend wherever a student's school can change: signup, Clever and CSV roster sync, SSO login, profile edit, teacher cascade, and admin partner-org edit. A new school partnership also writes `users_schools` now, which it had been skipping, and a one-time script backfills students active since Aug 1, 2025. ([subway !2977](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2977)) *Macy Lam*

### Fixes

- 🚀 **Switch the whiteboard to read-only when its connection silently drops.** Two people in a session could keep drawing and uploading screenshots the other never saw, because the whiteboard WebSocket failed without saying so. high-line pings zwibserve and, with no matching reply within 10 seconds, marks the whiteboard disconnected and read-only. 🐛 [#721](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/721) ([high-line !1921](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1921); zwibserve's side in [graffiti !3](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/graffiti/-/merge_requests/3)) *Kasozi Wilson*
- 🚀 **Put the app back on Vuetify's light theme.** Vuetify 4 follows the system theme by default, so on a device set to dark mode our text fields went white against the white page. ([high-line !1932](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1932)) *Kasozi Wilson*
- 🚀 **Sharpen the illustration on the volunteer signup page.** It was reported as really blurry. It is exported at twice the size and then compressed, taking the PNG from 64 KB to 123 KB and the AVIF version from 52 KB to 80 KB. 🐛 [#722](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/722) ([high-line !1931](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1931)) *sammy nave*
- 🚀 **Stop the volunteer dashboard throwing on its Google sign-up path, and turn on `no-undef` for Vue files so lint catches the next one.** A bare `store.dispatch` threw a `ReferenceError` for student-volunteers and existing volunteers who clicked Sign Up with Google. The dispatch is gone rather than fixed, since the welcome modal it opened says they passed the quiz, which fits neither; new SSO volunteers already go through `/welcome`. ([high-line !1926](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1926)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Let each local environment keep its own login.** The session cookie name comes from an env var now, defaulting to `connect.sid` so dev, staging, and production are unchanged, and a developer running several environments locally can be signed in to each one independently. ([subway !2968](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2968)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 👀 **Stop PhotoDNA errors from turning into failed uploads and false matches:** ID photos over 4 MB stopped before upload, checked when picked and again after conversion, which can grow them, with a message saying the photo is too large; a volunteer uploading their ID kept getting an error telling them to contact support 🐛 [#726](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/726) ([subway !2981](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2981), [high-line !1936](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1936)); a failed or malformed PhotoDNA response returns a 503 asking the user to retry instead of being reported as a match, match details are saved as JSON instead of `[object Object]`, and database or quarantine-upload failures keep their own errors instead of becoming a `PhotoDnaMatchError` ([subway !2983](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2983)); unsupported formats rejected for ID photos and session image uploads while PhotoDNA is on, with assignment PDFs left as they are ([subway !2984](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2984)). *Kasozi Wilson*
- 👀 **Make the back link and the browser back button close the photo ID modal.** On a phone, the "back" link on the photo ID modal did nothing, and the browser's back button left the dashboard instead. The back link shared the backdrop-click handler, which only fires on a click on the overlay itself, so it was dead on every modal that shows one; the photo ID modal also pushes a history entry now and closes on back. 🐛 [#641](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/641) ([high-line !1758](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1758)) *Macy Lam*
- 👀 **Let a fresh local database start again.** [subway !2938](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2938) brought in `db_init` files from a newer `pg_dump` carrying `SET transaction_timeout = 0`, a Postgres 17 setting; we run 15, so a fresh database failed with `unrecognized configuration parameter`. ([subway !2985](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2985)) *Alex Lindsay*

### Internal tools

- 👀 **Show admins the whole record for a student-volunteer:** the last name on the admin detail page, which the query hid for anyone with a student profile, so photo ID reviewers had to go back to the review list to read it 🐛 [#716](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/716) ([subway !2894](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2894)); a volunteer's self-reported grade level in the review card's background info, which never appeared because it was joined through the student profile ([subway !2971](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2971), [high-line !1927](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1927)); a chip for each role in place of the "Type" line, with the experimental-account banner and the "(primary)" and "(experimental)" wording gone ([high-line !1867](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1867)). *Macy Lam*
- 👀 **Let admins save changes to a student-volunteer with a partner org.** An admin trying to lift a student's ban could not save it. `adminUpdateUser` matched the partner org against the account's current role instead of its original one, which is the role a partner org belongs to today. 🐛 [#724](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/724) ([subway !2982](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2982)) *Jamie Kasulis*
